title: Retry one request without duplicating its effect
description: A small example acceptance contract for Loopbreaker.

behaviors.title: Persist acceptance before invoking the external effect
behaviors.trigger: A worker accepts an external-effect request
behaviors.expected: Acceptance is durable before the external call starts
behaviors.verify: Trace one wired request and observe persistence before invocation

behaviors.title: A replay produces the external effect exactly once
behaviors.expected: The external effect occurs exactly once
behaviors.verify: Replay twice through the wired worker and observe one effect

behaviors.title: Show operator timing diagnostics
behaviors.expected: Timing fields are visible in structured diagnostics
behaviors.verify: Inspect one retry log and observe the timing fields

planning.outcome: A replayed request produces exactly one external effect.

work_units.title: Wire durable acceptance and replay protection
work_units.done_when: The production worker satisfies the two enforced behaviors and retains diagnostics.

proofs.method: Trace persistence before the external invocation.
Replay twice and observe one external effect.

planning.production_wiring: Construct replay protection in the production worker and external SDK adapter.
planning.rollback: Disable replay reuse and return to the cold execution path.

risks.risk: The external SDK ignores idempotency keys.
